title: triad leg A — architecture and blast radius
description: Structured output contract for leg A (claude --json-schema). Mirrors the finding fields in architecture.md — do not add fields here without updating that prompt to match. Leg A has no ticket, so there is no no_ticket status.

status.description: no_findings: reviewed, nothing to report. findings: one or more findings below.

findings.description: Empty for no_findings. One entry per defect for findings, ordered by severity.

what.description: The defect and the path traced to find it.

evidence.description: The named consumer, decision-log entry, or arch doc checked.
